run_task.title: Run an agent task (create a v3 session)
run_task.description: Create a v3 agent session and/or dispatch a natural-language task to the Browser Use agent. With no session_id and a task it starts a new session and runs the task; with session_id it dispatches a follow-up to an existing idle session (task then required); with neither it creates an idle session (e.g. to upload files first). The call returns immediately with the session (status, liveUrl) — poll get_session for status and output. By default the session stops when the task finishes; set keep_alive to keep it idle for follow-ups. Use create_browser for a raw CDP browser with no agent, or create_task for the cheaper legacy v2 agent.
run_task.notes: Costs credits: LLM, proxy and browser time are billed to the project.

task.description: The natural-language instruction for the agent, e.g. "Go to amazon.com and find the best-rated wireless mouse under $50". Required when session_id is set.

model.description: Agent model. gemini-3-flash is fast and cheap, claude-sonnet-5 balanced, claude-opus-4.7 most capable (provider default), claude-opus-4.8 newest Opus. GPT-5.6 models may need use_own_key unless native routing is configured.

thinking_level.description: Model reasoning depth. Omit for the provider default; supported values depend on the model.

session_id.description: An existing idle session to dispatch the task to. Omit to create a new session.

keep_alive.description: Keep the session idle after the task finishes so follow-up tasks keep browser state and files. Provider default: false.

max_cost_usd.description: Maximum total USD cost for the session; the task stops when reached. On a follow-up dispatch this overrides the session budget. Omit for the default limit (capped by balance).

profile_id.description: Browser profile to load (cookies, local storage, logins). See create_profile.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to attach for persistent file storage across sessions. See create_workspace.

proxy_country_code.description: Lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to route browser traffic through (e.g. us, de, jp; uk is also accepted). Provider default: us. The API disables the proxy only on an explicit null, which this tool cannot send; use custom_proxy to route elsewhere.

browser_screen_width.description: Custom browser screen width in pixels (320-6144). Set together with the height.

browser_screen_height.description: Custom browser screen height in pixels (320-3456). Set together with the width.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the agent's final output must conform to; the structured result comes back in `output`, e.g. {"type":"object","properties":{"price":{"type":"number"}}}.

enable_scheduled_tasks.description: Let the agent create recurring scheduled tasks tied to the project (visible project-wide). Provider default: false.

sensitive_data.description: Map of placeholder name to secret value (passwords, API keys). Keys are shown to the LLM, values never are; the agent types them via <secret>key</secret> placeholders.

enable_recording.description: Record a video of the browser session; URLs appear in recordingUrls on get_session. Provider default: false.

skills.description: Generate and persist reusable per-domain skills from the completed task. Set false for privacy-sensitive tasks or to skip the extra LLM cost. Provider default: true.

agentmail.description: Provision a temporary AgentMail inbox for the session (agentmailEmail in the response), for sign-ups and email verification. Provider default: true.

code_mode.description: Return structured output with `text` (summary) and `code` (validated Python source) instead of free-form text. Provider default: false.

cache_script.description: Deterministic script caching. Omit for auto (on when the task has @{{value}} brackets and a workspace is attached); true forces on, false forces off. The first run saves a reusable script that later identical calls replay.

use_own_key.description: Use your own LLM provider key configured in project settings; you pay the provider and Browser Use charges a reduced orchestration fee. Provider default: false.

auto_heal.description: With script caching active, validate cached output with a lightweight LLM and re-run the full agent if it looks wrong. Provider default: true.

output.description: The v3 agent session: id, status (created, idle, running, stopped, timed_out, error), model, title, output, isTaskSuccessful, stepCount, lastStepSummary, liveUrl, recordingUrls, screenshotUrl, profileId, workspaceId, agentmailEmail, token counts and USD costs (llmCostUsd, proxyCostUsd, browserCostUsd, totalCostUsd).

status.description: created -> idle -> running -> stopped / timed_out / error.

output.description: The agent's final output: free text, structured data matching outputSchema, or {text, code, output} in codeMode.

isTaskSuccessful.description: Whether the agent achieved the goal; null while running.

liveUrl.description: Embeddable live view of the browser.

list_sessions.title: List v3 agent sessions
list_sessions.description: List the project's v3 agent sessions, newest first, a page at a time. Returns sessions, total, page and page_size. List items omit screenshotUrl and recordingUrls; call get_session for those and for live polling of one session.

page.description: 1-indexed page number to return. Provider default: 1.

output.description: A page of sessions: sessions, total, page, page_size.

get_session.title: Get a v3 agent session
get_session.description: Fetch one v3 agent session — the endpoint to poll for task completion. Returns status, output, isTaskSuccessful, step count and last step summary, live URL, a fresh screenshotUrl (5-minute presign), recordingUrls and the cost breakdown. Use list_session_messages for the step-by-step conversation.

output.description: The v3 agent session: id, status (created, idle, running, stopped, timed_out, error), model, title, output, isTaskSuccessful, stepCount, lastStepSummary, liveUrl, recordingUrls, screenshotUrl, profileId, workspaceId, agentmailEmail, token counts and USD costs (llmCostUsd, proxyCostUsd, browserCostUsd, totalCostUsd).

status.description: created -> idle -> running -> stopped / timed_out / error.

output.description: The agent's final output: free text, structured data matching outputSchema, or {text, code, output} in codeMode.

isTaskSuccessful.description: Whether the agent achieved the goal; null while running.

liveUrl.description: Embeddable live view of the browser.

delete_session.title: Delete a v3 agent session
delete_session.description: Soft-delete a v3 agent session, stopping its sandbox first if it is still running. Returns 204 with no body. Use stop_session to stop without deleting.

output.description: Empty on success (204).

stop_session.title: Stop a v3 session or its running task
stop_session.description: Stop a v3 agent session or just its running task. strategy=session (default) destroys the sandbox and the session becomes stopped; strategy=task halts the current task and leaves the session idle for a follow-up run_task. Returns the updated session.

strategy.description: session destroys the sandbox entirely; task stops only the current task and keeps the session alive. Provider default: session.

output.description: The v3 agent session: id, status (created, idle, running, stopped, timed_out, error), model, title, output, isTaskSuccessful, stepCount, lastStepSummary, liveUrl, recordingUrls, screenshotUrl, profileId, workspaceId, agentmailEmail, token counts and USD costs (llmCostUsd, proxyCostUsd, browserCostUsd, totalCostUsd).

status.description: created -> idle -> running -> stopped / timed_out / error.

output.description: The agent's final output: free text, structured data matching outputSchema, or {text, code, output} in codeMode.

isTaskSuccessful.description: Whether the agent achieved the goal; null while running.

liveUrl.description: Embeddable live view of the browser.

list_session_messages.title: List a v3 session's messages
list_session_messages.description: Read the messages of a v3 agent session in chronological order — the agent's steps, tool calls and replies — with cursor pagination via after/before message ids. Returns messages and hasMore. Use get_session for the final output and status.

after.description: Cursor: return messages after this message id.

before.description: Cursor: return messages before this message id.

limit.description: Maximum messages to return (1-100). Provider default: 10.

output.description: messages (id, role, content, timestamps) and hasMore.

list_browsers.title: List browser sessions
list_browsers.description: List raw cloud browser sessions (no agent), optionally filtered by status, linked agent session or metadata tags. Returns items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize; recordingUrl is always null here — call get_browser for it.

metadata.description: Tag filters, all of which must match: `key` matches any value, `key=value` matches exactly.

page_size.description: How many browser sessions per page (1-100). Provider default: 10.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number to return. Provider default: 1.

agent_session_id.description: Only browsers belonging to this agent session.

output.description: A page of browser sessions: items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize.

create_browser.title: Create a browser session
create_browser.description: Start a raw stealth cloud browser you drive yourself over CDP (Playwright, Puppeteer) — no agent. Returns the session with cdpUrl and liveUrl. Billed at $0.02/hour, charged upfront for the timeout and refunded pro rata (per minute, 1 minute minimum) when you stop it with stop_browser; max 4 hours. Use run_task instead to have the agent do the browsing.
create_browser.notes: Charges $0.02/hour upfront for the timeout; unused time is refunded on stop.

profile_id.description: Profile to load into the browser (persisted cookies and logins).

proxy_country_code.description: Lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to route browser traffic through (e.g. us, de, jp; uk is also accepted). Provider default: us. The API disables the proxy only on an explicit null, which this tool cannot send; use custom_proxy to route elsewhere.

metadata.description: Up to 10 string key-value labels, filterable in list_browsers and the dashboard.

timeout.description: Session timeout in minutes (1-240). Provider default: 60.

browser_screen_width.description: Custom browser screen width in pixels (320-6144). Set together with the height.

browser_screen_height.description: Custom browser screen height in pixels (320-3456). Set together with the width.

allow_resizing.description: Allow resizing the browser during the session (reduces stealth). Provider default: false.

pdf_renderer_enabled.description: Render PDFs in a tab; the file is saved to downloads either way. Provider default: true.

solve_captchas.description: Detect and solve CAPTCHAs automatically. Provider default: true.

custom_proxy.description: Your own proxy instead of Browser Use's: {host (required), port (required, 1-65535), username, password, ignoreCertErrors (boolean, for self-signed certs like Burp or corporate proxies)}.

enable_recording.description: Record the session. Provider default: false.

extension_ids.description: Up to 3 ready extension ids (uploaded via the v4 extensions API) to install before the browser starts.

output.description: The browser session: id, status (active or stopped), liveUrl, cdpUrl for connecting Playwright/Puppeteer over CDP, timeoutAt, startedAt, finishedAt, recordingUrl (single-session fetch only), proxy usage and cost.

get_browser.title: Get a browser session
get_browser.description: Fetch one raw browser session with its status, cdpUrl, liveUrl, timeoutAt and a signed recordingUrl when recording was enabled. Use list_browser_downloads for files the browser downloaded.

output.description: The browser session: id, status (active or stopped), liveUrl, cdpUrl for connecting Playwright/Puppeteer over CDP, timeoutAt, startedAt, finishedAt, recordingUrl (single-session fetch only), proxy usage and cost.

stop_browser.title: Stop a browser session
stop_browser.description: Stop a running raw browser session (PATCH with action=stop). Unused prepaid time is refunded pro rata, rounded up to the minute. Returns the stopped session. The browser cannot be restarted; create_browser starts a new one.

output.description: The browser session: id, status (active or stopped), liveUrl, cdpUrl for connecting Playwright/Puppeteer over CDP, timeoutAt, startedAt, finishedAt, recordingUrl (single-session fetch only), proxy usage and cost.

list_browser_downloads.title: List a browser session's downloads
list_browser_downloads.description: List files the browser downloaded during a session (stored privately in S3), cursor-paginated. Set include_urls to get 15-minute presigned download URLs inline. Returns files plus the next cursor.

include_urls.description: Include presigned download URLs (15 min expiry). Provider default: false.

output.description: files (path, size, lastModified, url when requested), nextCursor, hasMore.

list_profiles.title: List browser profiles
list_profiles.description: List the project's browser profiles a page at a time; `query` searches by name or userId (handy when you set userId to your own user identifier). Returns items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize. Use get_profile for one profile.

page_size.description: How many profiles per page (1-100). Provider default: 10.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number to return. Provider default: 1.

query.description: Search profiles by name or userId (max 200 chars).

output.description: A page of profiles: items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize.

create_profile.title: Create a browser profile
create_profile.description: Create a browser profile that preserves browser state (cookies, local storage, logins) between sessions — typically one per end user, loaded via profile_id on run_task or create_browser. Returns the new profile with its id.

user_id.description: Your internal user identifier for this profile, searchable later via list_profiles query (max 255 chars).

output.description: The profile: id, name, userId, lastUsedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, cookieDomains.

get_profile.title: Get a browser profile
get_profile.description: Fetch one browser profile by id: name, userId, cookie domains and last-used time. Use list_profiles to search by name or userId.

output.description: The profile: id, name, userId, lastUsedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, cookieDomains.

update_profile.title: Update a browser profile
update_profile.description: Rename a browser profile or change its userId. Returns the updated profile. The stored browser state is untouched.

output.description: The profile: id, name, userId, lastUsedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, cookieDomains.

delete_profile.title: Delete a browser profile
delete_profile.description: Permanently delete a browser profile and its stored state (cookies, logins). Returns 204 with no body; this cannot be undone.

output.description: Empty on success (204).

list_workspaces.title: List workspaces
list_workspaces.description: List the project's v3 workspaces — persistent file stores shared across sessions — a page at a time. Returns items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize. Use list_workspace_files for the files inside one.

page_size.description: How many workspaces per page (1-100). Provider default: 10.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number to return. Provider default: 1.

output.description: A page of workspaces: items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize.

create_workspace.title: Create a workspace
create_workspace.description: Create a workspace for persistent file storage that carries across agent sessions; attach it via workspace_id on run_task. Returns the new workspace with its id.

output.description: The workspace: id, name, createdAt, updatedAt.

get_workspace.title: Get a workspace
get_workspace.description: Fetch one workspace's details by id (name and timestamps). Use get_workspace_size for storage usage and list_workspace_files for its contents.

output.description: The workspace: id, name, createdAt, updatedAt.

update_workspace.title: Rename a workspace
update_workspace.description: Change a workspace's name. Returns the updated workspace; files are untouched.

output.description: The workspace: id, name, createdAt, updatedAt.

delete_workspace.title: Delete a workspace
delete_workspace.description: Delete a workspace together with all its stored files in S3. Returns 204 with no body; this cannot be undone. Use delete_workspace_file to remove a single file.

output.description: Empty on success (204).

list_workspace_files.title: List workspace files
list_workspace_files.description: List files stored in a workspace, optionally under a path prefix, cursor-paginated. Set include_urls for presigned download URLs and shallow to list only one directory level. Returns files plus the next cursor.

prefix.description: Only files under this relative path prefix, e.g. uploads/.

include_urls.description: Include presigned download URLs. Provider default: false.

shallow.description: List only the immediate level under the prefix instead of recursing. Provider default: false.

output.description: files (path, size, lastModified, url when requested), folders when shallow, nextCursor, hasMore.

delete_workspace_file.title: Delete a workspace file
delete_workspace_file.description: Delete one file from a workspace by its relative path. Returns 204 with no body. Use delete_workspace to drop the whole workspace.

path.description: Relative path of the file to delete, as list_workspace_files reports it.

output.description: Empty on success (204).

get_workspace_size.title: Get workspace storage usage
get_workspace_size.description: Return the current storage usage of a workspace (bytes used and file count as the API reports them). Use list_workspace_files to see what takes the space.

output.description: Storage usage figures for the workspace.

upload_workspace_files.title: Get upload URLs for workspace files
upload_workspace_files.description: Request presigned PUT URLs for uploading 1-10 files into a workspace, optionally under a directory prefix. This call uploads nothing itself: PUT each file's bytes to its returned URL with the same Content-Type. Returns files with name, uploadUrl and path.

files.description: 1-10 files to upload: each {name (filename, required), contentType (MIME type, default application/octet-stream), size (bytes, required for workspace uploads)}.

prefix.description: Directory prefix to upload into, e.g. uploads/.

output.description: files: presigned upload targets (name, uploadUrl, path, expiry).

get_account_billing.title: Get account billing and limits
get_account_billing.description: Return the authenticated project's account and billing state: total, monthly and additional credit balances in USD, concurrentSessionLimit, activeSessionCount, plan info, projectId and whether it is on the free tier. rateLimit is a legacy alias of the concurrency limit, not requests per second.

output.description: Account view: name, totalCreditsBalanceUsd, monthlyCreditsBalanceUsd, additionalCreditsBalanceUsd, concurrentSessionLimit, activeSessionCount, planInfo, isFreeTier, projectId, apiKeyId.

list_tasks.title: List v2 tasks
list_tasks.description: List v2 agent tasks a page at a time, optionally filtered by v2 session, status and creation window. Returns items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize. v3 agent runs are sessions — use list_sessions for those.
list_tasks.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

page_size.description: How many tasks per page (1-100). Provider default: 10.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number to return. Provider default: 1.

session_id.description: Only tasks in this v2 session.

after.description: Only tasks created after this ISO 8601 datetime.

before.description: Only tasks created before this ISO 8601 datetime.

output.description: A page of tasks: items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize.

create_task.title: Create a v2 task
create_task.description: Create and start a task on the lower-cost v2 agent. Without session_id it auto-creates a one-off session (US proxy by default, configurable via session_settings) that closes when the task ends; with session_id it runs as a follow-up in an existing v2 session. Returns the task id and session id — poll get_task_status, then get_task for steps and output files. Use run_task for the v3 agent.
create_task.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key). Costs credits.

task.description: The task prompt for the agent (1-50000 chars).

start_url.description: URL to start the task from.

max_steps.description: Maximum agent steps before stopping (1-10000). Provider default: 100.

structured_output.description: Stringified JSON Schema the output must match.

session_id.description: Existing v2 session to run the task in.

metadata.description: Up to 10 string key-value pairs stored with the task.

secrets.description: Map of secret name to value injected into the task; pair with allowed_domains.

op_vault_id.description: 1Password vault id to inject secrets from.

session_settings.description: Settings for the auto-created session (ignored with session_id): {profileId, proxyCountryCode, browserScreenWidth, browserScreenHeight, enableRecording}.

highlight_elements.description: Highlight interactive elements on the page. Provider default: false.

flash_mode.description: Enable agent flash mode. Provider default: false.

thinking.description: Enable agent thinking mode. Provider default: false.

thinking_level.description: Model reasoning depth; omit for the provider default.

vision.description: Enable agent vision. Provider default: true (the API also accepts "auto").

system_prompt_extension.description: Extra text appended to the agent system prompt (max 10000 chars).

judge.description: Evaluate completion against judge_ground_truth. Provider default: false.

judge_ground_truth.description: Expected answer for judge evaluation (max 10000 chars).

judge_llm.description: LLM used for judging; omit for the default judge.

skill_ids.description: Skill ids to enable for this task; ["*"] enables all of the project's skills.

output.description: The created task reference: id and sessionId.

get_task.title: Get a v2 task
get_task.description: Fetch a v2 task in full: status, steps, output, output files, success flag, judge verdict and cost. Heavy — for polling use get_task_status and call this once at the end.
get_task.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: The v2 task: id, sessionId, llm, task, status (created, started, finished, failed, stopped), createdAt, startedAt, finishedAt, metadata, steps, output, outputFiles, isSuccess, judgement, judgeVerdict, cost, suggestions.

stop_task.title: Stop a v2 task
stop_task.description: Stop a running v2 task (action=stop), or stop it and close its session too (action=stop_task_and_session). Returns the updated task.
stop_task.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

action.description: stop halts the task; stop_task_and_session also ends the session.

output.description: The v2 task: id, sessionId, llm, task, status (created, started, finished, failed, stopped), createdAt, startedAt, finishedAt, metadata, steps, output, outputFiles, isSuccess, judgement, judgeVerdict, cost, suggestions.

get_task_status.title: Poll a v2 task's status
get_task_status.description: Lightweight polling endpoint for a v2 task: returns only id, status, output, finishedAt, isSuccess and cost. Poll until status is finished or stopped, then call get_task once for steps and files.
get_task_status.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: id, status, output, finishedAt, isSuccess, cost.

get_task_logs.title: Get a v2 task's log download URL
get_task_logs.description: Get a secure, expiring download URL for a v2 task's step-by-step execution log file. Returns downloadUrl; fetch the file from it separately.
get_task_logs.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: downloadUrl for the log file.

get_task_output_file.title: Get a v2 task output file URL
get_task_output_file.description: Get a secure download URL for one output file a v2 task produced (file ids come from get_task outputFiles). Returns id, fileName and downloadUrl.
get_task_output_file.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

file_id.description: The output file id from get_task.

output.description: id, fileName, downloadUrl.

create_session_upload_url.title: Get a v2 agent session upload URL
create_session_upload_url.description: Get a presigned URL for uploading one file (max 10 MB, common image, PDF, Office, text, CSV or Markdown types) into a v2 agent session so its tasks can use it. Returns the upload URL and fields; upload the bytes to it separately. For v3 sessions upload into a workspace with upload_workspace_files.
create_session_upload_url.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

file_name.description: Name of the file to upload (max 255 chars).

output.description: url, method, fields, fileName, expiresIn for the presigned upload.

create_browser_upload_url.title: Get a browser session upload URL
create_browser_upload_url.description: Get a presigned URL for uploading one file (max 10 MB) into a raw browser session, e.g. for a file input. Returns the upload URL and fields; upload the bytes to it separately.
create_browser_upload_url.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

file_name.description: Name of the file to upload (max 255 chars).

output.description: url, method, fields, fileName, expiresIn for the presigned upload.

list_v2_sessions.title: List v2 agent sessions
list_v2_sessions.description: List v2 agent sessions (the containers v2 tasks run in), optionally filtered by status. Returns items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize. For v3 sessions use list_sessions.
list_v2_sessions.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

page_size.description: How many sessions per page (1-100). Provider default: 10.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number to return. Provider default: 1.

output.description: A page of v2 sessions: items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize.

create_v2_session.title: Create a v2 agent session
create_v2_session.description: Create a v2 agent session to run several v2 tasks in with shared browser state and memory. Pass its id as session_id to create_task. Returns the session with its liveUrl. For the v3 agent use run_task.
create_v2_session.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

profile_id.description: Profile to load into the session.

proxy_country_code.description: Lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to route browser traffic through (e.g. us, de, jp; uk is also accepted). Provider default: us. The API disables the proxy only on an explicit null, which this tool cannot send; use custom_proxy to route elsewhere.

start_url.description: URL to open when the session starts.

browser_screen_width.description: Custom browser screen width in pixels (320-6144). Set together with the height.

browser_screen_height.description: Custom browser screen height in pixels (320-3456). Set together with the width.

persist_memory.description: Tasks in the session share memory and history. Provider default: true.

keep_alive.description: Keep the browser alive after tasks finish for follow-ups. Provider default: true.

custom_proxy.description: Your own proxy instead of Browser Use's: {host (required), port (required, 1-65535), username, password, ignoreCertErrors (boolean, for self-signed certs like Burp or corporate proxies)}.

enable_recording.description: Record the session. Provider default: false.

output.description: The v2 agent session: id, status (active or stopped), liveUrl, recordingUrl, startedAt, finishedAt, tasks, publicShareUrl, persistMemory, keepAlive, proxyUsedMb, proxyCost.

get_v2_session.title: Get a v2 agent session
get_v2_session.description: Fetch one v2 agent session with its status, liveUrl, recordingUrl, tasks and public share URL. Use get_session for v3 sessions.
get_v2_session.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: The v2 agent session: id, status (active or stopped), liveUrl, recordingUrl, startedAt, finishedAt, tasks, publicShareUrl, persistMemory, keepAlive, proxyUsedMb, proxyCost.

stop_v2_session.title: Stop a v2 agent session
stop_v2_session.description: Stop a v2 agent session and all its running tasks (action=stop). Returns the stopped session.
stop_v2_session.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: The v2 agent session: id, status (active or stopped), liveUrl, recordingUrl, startedAt, finishedAt, tasks, publicShareUrl, persistMemory, keepAlive, proxyUsedMb, proxyCost.

delete_v2_session.title: Delete a v2 agent session
delete_v2_session.description: Delete a v2 agent session together with all its tasks. Cannot be undone. Use stop_v2_session to only stop it.
delete_v2_session.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

purge_v2_session.title: Purge a session's data (ZDR)
purge_v2_session.description: Immediately purge all data for a session on a zero-data-retention project: redacts PII from records and deletes every S3 object (screenshots, output and uploaded files, logs, history, downloads, agent state) with no grace period. ZDR projects only; irreversible.
purge_v2_session.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: Purge confirmation.

get_session_public_share.description: Get the public share link of a v2 session with usage stats: shareToken, shareUrl, viewCount, lastViewedAt. 404 when the session is not shared; create_session_public_share makes one.

delete_session_public_share.description: Remove the public share link of a v2 session so the URL stops working. Returns 204 with no body.

output.description: Empty on success (204).

list_skills.title: List skills
list_skills.description: List the project's skills (generated, callable web automations) with filters for public/enabled flags, category, text query and creation window. Returns items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize. Use list_marketplace_skills for public skills from others.
list_skills.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

page_size.description: How many skills per page (1-100). Provider default: 10.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number to return. Provider default: 1.

from_date.description: Only skills created on or after this ISO 8601 datetime.

to_date.description: Only skills created on or before this ISO 8601 datetime.

output.description: A page of skills: items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize.

create_skill.title: Create a skill
create_skill.description: Start automated generation of a skill: an agent works through agent_prompt to record and code a reusable, parameterised automation fulfilling goal. Generation runs asynchronously — poll get_skill until status is finished, then call execute_skill. Returns the new skill id.
create_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key). Generation costs credits.

goal.description: What the skill does and what callers should expect from it (max 1000 chars).

agent_prompt.description: Prompt the generating agent follows, at least 10 chars.

title.description: Optional title, generated if omitted (max 100 chars).

description.description: Optional description, generated if omitted (max 1000 chars).

output.description: The created skill reference: id.

get_skill.title: Get a skill
get_skill.description: Fetch one of the project's skills: generation status, parameters, output schema, code, version and flags. Use list_skill_executions for its run history.
get_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: The skill: id, slug, title, description, categories, domains, goal, agentPrompt, status (recording, generating, failed, finished, cancelled, timed_out), parameters, outputSchema, isEnabled, isPublic, currentVersion, code, clonedFromSkillId, createdAt, updatedAt.

update_skill.title: Update a skill
update_skill.description: Update a skill's metadata — title, description, categories, domains, or enable/disable it for execution. Returns the updated skill. Use refine_skill to change its behaviour.
update_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

description.description: What the skill does, shown publicly (max 1000 chars).

is_enabled.description: Whether the skill is enabled for execution.

output.description: The skill: id, slug, title, description, categories, domains, goal, agentPrompt, status (recording, generating, failed, finished, cancelled, timed_out), parameters, outputSchema, isEnabled, isPublic, currentVersion, code, clonedFromSkillId, createdAt, updatedAt.

delete_skill.title: Delete a skill
delete_skill.description: Delete one of the project's skills. Fails while the skill is still generating — cancel_skill_generation first. Cannot be undone.
delete_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: Empty on success.

cancel_skill_generation.title: Cancel a skill's generation
cancel_skill_generation.description: Cancel the in-progress generation (or refinement) of a skill. Returns the skill with its updated status.
cancel_skill_generation.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: The skill: id, slug, title, description, categories, domains, goal, agentPrompt, status (recording, generating, failed, finished, cancelled, timed_out), parameters, outputSchema, isEnabled, isPublic, currentVersion, code, clonedFromSkillId, createdAt, updatedAt.

rollback_skill.title: Roll a skill back a version
rollback_skill.description: Roll a skill back to its previous version. The provider states this cannot be undone, and public skills cannot be rolled back. Returns the skill.
rollback_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: The skill: id, slug, title, description, categories, domains, goal, agentPrompt, status (recording, generating, failed, finished, cancelled, timed_out), parameters, outputSchema, isEnabled, isPublic, currentVersion, code, clonedFromSkillId, createdAt, updatedAt.

execute_skill.title: Execute a skill
execute_skill.description: Run one of the project's finished skills with the given parameters and wait for the result. Returns success, result, error, stderr and latencyMs. Use execute_marketplace_skill for a public skill you have not cloned.
execute_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key). Costs credits.

parameters.description: Parameters for the skill handler, keyed by the parameter names get_skill lists.

session_id.description: Optional session id to reuse for IP persistence.

output.description: success, result (the skill's output), error, stderr, latencyMs.

refine_skill.title: Refine a skill with feedback
refine_skill.description: Start a refinement of a skill from written feedback, optionally including the last test output and logs as context. Runs asynchronously like generation — poll get_skill. Returns the refinement reference.
refine_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

feedback.description: What to improve, at least 10 chars.

test_output.description: Last skill test output, for context.

test_logs.description: Last skill test logs, for context.

output.description: Refinement reference for the skill.

list_skill_executions.title: List a skill's executions
list_skill_executions.description: List past executions of a skill a page at a time. Returns items (id, status, timings, latency) with totals. Use get_skill_execution_output for one execution's output file.
list_skill_executions.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

page_size.description: How many executions per page (1-100). Provider default: 10.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number to return. Provider default: 1.

output.description: A page of executions: items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize.

get_skill_execution_output.title: Get a skill execution's output URL
get_skill_execution_output.description: Get a presigned URL for downloading the output of one skill execution. Returns downloadUrl; fetch the file separately.
get_skill_execution_output.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: downloadUrl for the execution output.

list_marketplace_skills.title: List marketplace skills
list_marketplace_skills.description: Browse public skills in the Browser Use marketplace, with text query, category and publish-date filters. Returns items (id, slug, title, categories, domains, parameters, cloneCount, isOfficial) with totals. Use clone_marketplace_skill to copy one into your project.
list_marketplace_skills.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

page_size.description: How many skills per page (1-100). Provider default: 10.

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number to return. Provider default: 1.

from_date.description: Only skills from this ISO 8601 datetime on.

to_date.description: Only skills up to this ISO 8601 datetime.

output.description: A page of marketplace skills: items, totalItems, pageNumber, pageSize.

get_marketplace_skill.title: Get a marketplace skill
get_marketplace_skill.description: Fetch one public marketplace skill by its slug, with parameters, output schema, domains and clone count. Note: addressed by slug here, while clone and execute take the skill id.
get_marketplace_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: The marketplace skill: id, slug, title, description, categories, domains, parameters, outputSchema, currentVersion, isOfficial, cloneCount.

clone_marketplace_skill.title: Clone a marketplace skill
clone_marketplace_skill.description: Copy a public marketplace skill into your project so you can execute, edit and refine it as your own. Returns the new project skill.
clone_marketplace_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key).

output.description: The skill: id, slug, title, description, categories, domains, goal, agentPrompt, status (recording, generating, failed, finished, cancelled, timed_out), parameters, outputSchema, isEnabled, isPublic, currentVersion, code, clonedFromSkillId, createdAt, updatedAt.

execute_marketplace_skill.title: Execute a marketplace skill
execute_marketplace_skill.description: Run a public marketplace skill directly with the given parameters, without cloning it. Returns success, result, error, stderr and latencyMs.
execute_marketplace_skill.notes: Legacy v2 API (served from /api/v2 with the same API key). Costs credits.

parameters.description: Parameters for the skill handler, keyed by the parameter names get_skill lists.

session_id.description: Optional session id to reuse for IP persistence.

output.description: success, result (the skill's output), error, stderr, latencyMs.
